newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Iranian, Saudi leaders meet in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Iranian, Saudi leaders meet in Pakistan.

text.p: Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani and Saudi Crown Prince Abdullah held a rare meeting in Islamabad on Sunday on the sidelines of an Islamic summit, Iranian and Pakistani sources said.
There was no immediate official word after the hour-long meeting on just what was discussed by the leaders of the two countries, whose relations have been strained in recent years.
Pakistan's official APP news agency quoted unidentified diplomatic sources as saying both Rafsanjani and Abdullah had "stressed the need for improving relations" between their countries.
The sources quoted the Iranian president as saying that he was satisfied with the pace of improvement of bilateral ties.
